 BIG WIN: Wilmington Army veteran wins over $76K on ‘Wheel of Fortune’ 
 A Wilmington man walked away with a massive payday after dominating the Bonus Round on ‘Wheel of Fortune’ Thursday night. By Hannah Hall Published : Oct. 29, 2026 at 8:24 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WILMINGTON, N.C. (WECT) - A Wilmington man walked away with a massive payday after dominating the Bonus Round on ‘Wheel of Fortune’ Thursday night.
 Randolph “Moe” Moultrie claimed more than $76,000 in cash and prizes, including a getaway trip to Mexico, during the Oct. 29 Halloween-themed episode.
 Moultrie, an Army veteran, father of three and healthcare worker, grew up watching the iconic game show with his grandfather and described his appearance as a tribute to their bond.
 Over 100 friends, family members and community supporters gathered Thursday night at Four Corners Wrightsville Beach to celebrate the win and watch Moultrie solve his way to the winner’s circle.
